messages:
mina_csm: Quick heads-up — Noxus Med wants to spin up regional pilots in EU + APAC next quarter. They're adding 3 product squads (search, summarization, clinical QA). Likely ~3x current throughput. Asking for dedicated capacity recommendation and onboarding timeline. Also they've raised pricing/renewal questions during exec sync. cc @josh_sales @emily_onboard :eyes:
josh_sales: Great — what are their current committed units and renewal date? we should flag potential upsell vs. renewal risk.
mina_csm: Committed: 250k tokens/day reserved on hosted. Renewal: 2026-07-10. They used ~80% of reserved last month; spike expected during pilot. Execs asked about SLA for regional data residency.
emily_onboard: Onboarding checklist: infra docs, network allowlist, test dataset ingestion, runbook. Will need 1 dev week + 2 SRE days per region. Can we get estimate for Dedicated nodes + warmup time?
marco_eng: If it's 3x throughput, ballpark: 2 dedicated 8xA100 pools per region with autoscale to 4 during peak. What's their latency SLO?
mina_csm: Latency SLO: 95th <= 350ms for generation. Use cases: search 512 tokens, summarization 1024, QA 2048. They also care about KV cache persistence across requests for chat history.
lena_ops: I'll run cost/capacity calc. Quick Q: which model family are they targeting? Llama-2-chat? open-vicuna? need perf profile.
mina_csm: They're testing with redwood-3b-qa (internal alias) and open-vicuna-13b for heavy loads. Expect mixing embed calls too (400 req/min).
tom_support: Filed support ticket: #CS-4521 with network and billing asks. Link: https://redwood.support/tickets/CS-4521
analytics-bot: Dashboard updated: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/noxus-med/usage — 30d trend + projected spike (x3) if pilot goes live :chart_with_upwards_trend:
emily_onboard: Recommend: enable prefix caching, set batch_size to 32, sampling tweaks. I'll prepare runbook + test harness. ETA 3 business days to deliver.
lena_ops: Prelim estimate: per-region monthly cost ~ $27k for baseline nodes, $60k at peak autoscale. If they'd prefer predictable, propose Dedicated with commit discount. I'll attach calc in #billing.
josh_sales: I'll loop in their procurement and legal — @legal-bot can you flag any MSA adjustments for regional deployments/data residency?
legal-bot: Flag noted. If they require local data residency with private deployment, we'll need DPA addendum and possibly on-prem packaging. Tagging contracts@redwood.
marco_eng: We should consider a canary rollout per region and automatic fallback to hosted in other regions in case capacity issues.
mina_csm: Thanks all. Next actions: lena to post cost calc, emily to supply runbook, josh to start procurement convo. I'll schedule a technical kickoff for next Tue 10am PT. Anyone can't make it?
jordan_se: I can make it. Will bring SDK upgrade notes and sample prompt sets.
mina_csm: :thumbsup: setting calendar invite now. I'll update the ticket and mark renewal as 'watch' until pilot performance is validated.
